rows.grounds: possessive adjective describing Vāmana as wearing the sacred thread
second member of a bahuvrīhi-like description meaning having a blue hue
qualifies Vāmana as appearing in a deceptive or disguised form
name of the deity-form to be visualized

items.question: What visual form of the disguised Vāmana is prescribed for meditation?
premises: Vāmana is to be meditated upon.
He is described as wearing the sacred thread.
He is described as blue-hued and disguised.
items.inference: The practitioner should visualize Vāmana as a sacred-thread-wearing, blue-hued, disguised figure.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of chadma as deceptive appearance or disguise is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should meditate on Vāmana as wearing the sacred thread, blue in hue, and appearing in a disguised form.
